artifact_role: authoritative exact membership for P14 post-P13 subjective review cleanup queue
authoritative_scope_rule: Exact review issue ids in packages[].exact_review_issue_ids and dispositions[].exact_review_issue_id are authoritative for P14 accounting. Candidate files and commands are scoping aids only. Source cleanup must not start without a package-local execution-grade plan and review.
package_model: checklist-linked post-P13 score-targeted subjective review packages

score_target_goal.purpose: Raise the low P14 target subjective dimensions into the mid/high 80s without authorizing broad ownership churn.
score_target_goal.stop_condition: Continue P14 until AI generated debt, cross-module architecture, and design coherence are all >= 85, or stop earlier only after two consecutive fresh focused subjective reviews find no concrete source-backed issues that can be fixed without ownership churn, strict remains >= 88, and no P0/security findings or high-confidence source-backed design/coherence issues remain.
score_target_goal.non_closure_rule: Completing P14-W1, P14-W2, and P14-W3 closes only P14-WAVE1. It is not sufficient to close P14 or P14-EXIT without focused review, target-score evidence, and either all three target dimensions >= 85 or the early-stop condition recorded.

score_snapshot.source: post-P13 targeted review refresh and scan

post_wave1_focused_review.decision: P14 target dimensions remain below 85 with concrete source-backed issues; admit P14-WAVE2 and P14-WAVE3 packages before more implementation.

cli_inconsistency.status: desloppify status and desloppify plan show refreshed review work, while desloppify show review --status open --no-budget --top 120 reports no open review matches.
cli_inconsistency.planning_evidence: Use the refreshed review artifacts, triage artifacts, and desloppify plan as the authoritative P14 planning evidence unless a future integration-branch rerun supersedes them.

execution_waves.name: admitted-score-moving-cleanup
execution_waves.purpose: Implement the current admitted P14 issues as one coordinated wave that can move cross-module architecture, design coherence, and AI generated debt together.
execution_waves.ownership_rule: Wave membership is orchestration-only. Exact review issue ownership remains in packages[].exact_review_issue_ids, and the wave plan must keep separate slice closure conditions and verification for each package.
execution_waves.exit_boundary: P14-WAVE1 is complete as a source wave, but it is not P14 closure. Focused review left all three target dimensions below 85 and admitted WAVE2/WAVE3 follow-up packages.
execution_waves.planning_requirement: A single package-local execution-grade plan may cover the wave only if it includes a slice_table or equivalent ledger for P14-W1, P14-W2, and P14-W3 plus focused review after the wave.
verification_routing: all package-local scoping commands from the three wave packages
targeted rg audits from the three wave packages
fresh focused subjective review for design_coherence,cross_module_architecture,ai_generated_debt after wave closeout
replan_triggers: a slice requires ownership outside its package guardrail
a fix would relocate a hub responsibility instead of reducing ownership breadth
new same-area review or source-audit residue cannot be assigned to one package owner
targeted verification reveals behavior changes outside the approved wave scope

execution_waves.name: design-coherence-expansion-review-gate
execution_waves.purpose: After WAVE1, focused review left cross-module architecture and design coherence below target; execute admitted source-backed seams that reduce ownership breadth without opening P14-EXIT.
execution_waves.admission_rule: Do not activate broad AppOrchestrator, lifecycle, channel-setup, or Plex cleanup merely because files are large or stale detector wording exists. Admit only seams that reduce ownership breadth without relocating the same hub responsibility elsewhere and that have one owner, candidate files, and verification routing.
execution_waves.no_admission_result: If WAVE2 finds no concrete source-backed seam worth admitting, record it only as one focused-review pass toward the early-stop condition. It is not P14 closure by itself.
execution_waves.deferred_disposition_scope: The existing AppLifecycle, AppOrchestrator, ChannelSetupPlanner, and Plex discovery policy dispositions remain non-active unless WAVE2 produces fresh current-source proof that supersedes them.
verification_routing: current-source proof matrix for each newly admitted issue id

npm run verify:docs for checklist/package-map updates

execution_waves.name: ai-generated-debt-expansion-gate
execution_waves.purpose: After WAVE1, focused review left AI-generated debt below target; execute admitted behavior-neutral generated comment cleanup packages.
execution_waves.admission_rule: Additional files may be admitted only when targeted audits find generated-style banners or tautological comments/JSDoc and the planned patch remains behavior-neutral comment/API-doc cleanup.
execution_waves.no_admission_result: If WAVE3 finds no additional generated-style comment debt worth admitting, record it only as one audit/focused-review pass toward the early-stop condition. It is not P14 closure by itself.
